method: Code only, no probe. motion: 69 @keyframes: lobby v2.html 25 (tk, ltping, tkin, lpulse, lring, pl, winUp, wspin, evpulse, evhot, brcallring, brcallicon, nspin, npop, nshake, gosheen, gosheenw, scrIn, scrOut, sp-draw/in/out/fill splash, bsspin, tspin), dsEnd 9 (dse-rise, strike, drop, glint, ping, breathe, pop, fade, fall), battleship 5, swim 5, dead lobby.css 6, plus one or two per game.

14 separate spinner keyframes doing the same rotate: ahspin, bsspin, crspin, hsspin, kospin, p8spin, rtspin, swspin, tspin, brn-spin, dsd-spin, wspin, nspin, and the .i-spin/bsspin rings in the lobby.

Three reduced-motion policies: (a) lobby v2.html kills every animation and transition to .01ms with !important, then whitelists loading rings and the splash with more !important; (b) dsEnd, dsEmptyArena, dsDialog's ring, countUp and the splash deliberately play for everyone (Owen's PC reports reduce); (c) duel game CSS sets only '* { transition: none !important }' and keeps keyframes. dsShare (dss-rise), dsSeatHold, dsPerfHud and toasts.js have no reduced-motion handling of their own (toasts rely on the lobby rule, so the clipRec copy in games still slides).

prefers-reduced-motion appears in v2.html 13 times, once in each duel CSS, chomp, owner, join, clipPage, clipRec, dsChat, dsWatchBar, earnings; never in legal, ag, paper, sl, dead lobby.css. JS matchMedia for reduce in airhockey.js, game.js, v2.html.

Durations: 62 distinct values; lobby mostly .15s (63 uses) with .12/.13/.14/.2/.3/.5/.75/1.6/1.8s; dsEnd .3s/.28s/.22s; earnings and support .18s fade + .2s slide; DSToast .22s/.3s. 15 different cubic-bezier curves, none shared as a token.
Backdrop blur values: 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10 and 14px (header) for the same frosted-veil idea.
disagreements: There is no shared stylesheet: the lobby's tokens live in a 2,380-line <style> inside v2.html (lines 54-2436) and every other page re-declares its own copy, giving 14 shipped token sets, with owner.html, dsEnd, battleship and shooter already drifted (owner --s1 #16130f vs lobby #17140f, owner --tx2 #b3a793 vs #a89c8a).

19 different modal, sheet or dialog implementations; the lobby alone has 7 (howveil, upveil, mepop, bsheet, apscreen, earnings sheet, support sheet) with veils of rgba(6,5,4,.72), rgba(6,5,4,.86), rgba(8,7,5,.74) and rgba(0,0,0,.55), and card radii of 14, 16, 18, 20, 22 and 24px.
5 toast implementations: DSToast, a hand copy of it inside clipRec.js, the owner console's .lvtoast, chomp's Press Start box and the old engine's #gmsg.

At least 12 different primary-button looks: flat bone (.btn.pri, .enter, .clsend, .dse-btn.pri, .dss-btn.pri, 404 .go), bone gradient with sheen (.go, .evgo), gold gradient pill (.bs-go, DSDialog .dsd-go), a different gold gradient (.go.paid), green Arial gradient (Customize Save), solid gold (shooter .go, swimrace .seGo), and outline (duel .waitCard button, owner .btn).
Two gold gradients for the same 'pay' meaning: .go.paid #ffd98a > #f5b545 > #e0941f vs .bs-go/.dsd-go #f7c766 > #f0a830 > #c98a22.
Lobby buttons are borderless fills; every duel's wait card and the owner console use 1px outline buttons; Events uses a dashed-border button; Customize uses a 1.5px bordered back button.
6 close-button styles (40px bare cross, 44px round, 30px square r8 with a times sign, 30px with ×, 34px round, bare #888) and three different close glyphs.

Games and shared chrome use 9 font families the lobby never uses: Ubuntu (/ag), PT Sans Caption (/paper), Press Start 2P (/chomp), Sofia Sans Extra Condensed (/headsoccer), Arial and Lucida (/sl), Segoe UI/system-ui (dsChat on every game), system mono (dsPerfHud), Arial (dsEmptyArena, agar Back to lobby chip, the lobby's own Customize Save button).

The in-game chat (dsChat) is drawn in Segoe UI with cold blue-grey colours (#f3f5f8, rgba(14,16,22,.7)) while everything around it is warm Archivo; dsPerfHud uses Tailwind green/orange/red (#22c55e, #f97316, #ef4444).

Archivo is fetched with 8 different Google Fonts query strings (weights 400..700, 400-800, 400-900, italics), so no page shares the lobby's cached font CSS, and the lobby asks for weight 900 (.ap-title) and Plex Mono 700 that it never loads.

The lobby's own design rules (v2.html:56-67: no borders, no uppercase letter-spaced labels, one accent) are broken by the Customize screen (900-weight title with 3px letter-spacing, green Arial button) and by battleship, knockout and the old engine (9.5px uppercase 0.14em labels).
Radius tokens exist (6/10/18/999) but 41 radius values are in use, 26 inside v2.html itself; the pill is written as 999px, 99px and var(--rf).
No spacing scale: 51 px values for padding/margin/gap site-wide and 40 in v2.html, with odd steps 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17, 23 used as often as 8/16/24.
